G0301.def:
**Ἀμώς**, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָמוֹץ, [[Isa.1.1|Isa.1:1]] עָמוֹס, [[Amo.1.1|Amo.1:1]] אָמוֹן, [[2Ki.21.18|4Ki.21:18]] ff. B)
1. as in 2Ki, Lc. B (Α. Ἀμμών; Jos., Ἀμμών, "Αμωσσς), **Amon**: [[Mat.1.10|Mat.1:10]]
2. **Amos**: [[Luk.3.25|Luk.3:25]]†
(AS)

G0395.def:
**ἀνατολή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀνατέλλω), [in LXX chiefly for מִזְרָח קָדִים ;]
1. **a rising**: of light, [[Luk.1.78|Luk.1:78]]
2. **the sun-rising, the east **(MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Mat.2.2|Mat.2:2]], 9, [[Rev.21.13|Rev.21:13]]; ἀ. ἡλίου, [[Rev.7.2; 16.12|Rev.7:2 16:12]] (WΗ, p1.); pl., [[Mat.2.1; 8.11; 24.27|Mat.2:1 8:11 24:27]], [[Luk.13.29|Luk.13:29]].†
(AS)

G0344.def:
**ἀνα-κάμπτω **
[in LXX: [[1Ch.19.5|1Ch.19:5]], [[Jer.3.1|Jer.3:1]], al. (שׁוּב), [[Jer.15.5|Jer.15:5]] (סוּר) ;]
1. trans., to bend or turn back.
2. Intrans., **to return**: [[Mat.2.12|Mat.2:12]], [[Act.18.21|Act.18:21]], [[Heb.11.15|Heb.11:15]]; metaphorically (cf. MM, _VGT_, see word), [[Luk.10.6|Luk.10:6]]†
(AS)

G0302.def:
**ἄν**,
_conditional particle_,
which cannot usually be separately translated in English, its force depending on the constructions which contain it (see further, LS, see word; WM, §xlii; M, _Pr._, 165 ff.; MM, _VGT_, see word).
1. In apodosis,
(i) with indic, imperfect or aor., expressing what would be or would have been if (εἰ with impf., aor. or plpf.) some condition were or had been fulfilled: [[Luk.7.39; 17.6|Luk.7:39 17:6]], [[Jhn.5.46|Jhn.5:46]], [[Gal.1.10|Gal.1:10]], [[Mat.12.7; 24.43|Mat.12:7 24:43]], [[1Co.2.8|1Co.2:8]], [[Act.18.14|Act.18:14]], [[1Jn.2.19|1Jn.2:19]], al. The protasis is sometimes understood (as also in cl.): [[Mat.25.27|Mat.25:27]], [[Luk.19.23|Luk.19:23]]. In hypothetical sentences, expressing unreality, ἄν (as often in late writers, more rarely in cl.) is omitted: [[Jhn.8.39; 15.24; 19.11|Jhn.8:39 15:24 19:11]], [[Rom.7.7|Rom.7:7]], [[Gal.4.15|Gal.4:15]];
(ii) with opt., inf., ptcp. (cl.; see LS, see word; M, _Int._, §275; M, _Pr._, 167:4).
2. In combination with conditional, relative, temporal, and final words;
(i) as in cl., with subj.,
(a) in protasis with εἰ, in Attic contr. ἐάν, which see;
(b) in conditional, relative, and temporal clauses (coalescing with ὅτε, ἐπεί, etc.; see: ὅταν, ἐπάν, etc.), **ever, soever**;
(α) with pres., ἡνίκα, [[2Co.3.15|2Co.3:15]] ὃς ἄν, [[Rom.9.15|Rom.9:15]] (LXX) 16:2, al.; ὅσοι ἄν, [[Luk.9.5|Luk.9:5]] ὡς ἄν, [[Rom.15.24|Rom.15:24]] (M, _Pr._, 167);
(β) with aor., ὃς ἄν, [[Mat.5.21, 22, 31|Mat.5:21, 22, 31]]; ἕως ἄν, **until**, [[Mat.2.13|Mat.2:13]], [[Mrk.6.10|Mrk.6:10]], al.; ὡς ἄν, **as soon as** (M, _Pr._, 167), [[1Co.11.34|1Co.11:34]], [[Php.2.23|Php.2:23]]. On the frequently use of ἐάν for ἄν with the foregoing words, see: ἐάν;
(ii) in late Gk., when some actual fact is spoken of, with indic.: ὅταν (which see); ὅπου ἄν, [[Mrk.6.56|Mrk.6:56]] (M, _Pr._, 168); καθότι ἄν, [[Act.2.45; 4.35|Act.2:45 4:35]]; ὡς ἄν, [[1Co.12.2|1Co.12:2]]
3. in iterative construction, with imperfect and aor. indic. (M, _Pr._, 167): [[Act.2.45; 4.35|Act.2:45 4:35]], [[1Co.12.2|1Co.12:2]].
4. with optative, giving a potential sense to a question or wish: [[Act.8.31; 26.29|Act.8:31 26:29]].
5. **Elliptical constructions**: εἰ μή τι ἄν (M, _Pr._, 169), [[1Co.7.5|1Co.7:5]] ὡς ἄν, with inf., **as it were** (op. cit. 167), [[2Co.10.9|2Co.10:9]]
(AS)

G0305.def:
**ἀναβαίνω**
[in LXX chiefly for עָלָה ;]
**to go up, ascend, **
(a) **of persons**: ἐπί συκομωρέαν, [[Luk.19.4|Luk.19:4]] εἰς τ. πλοῖον, [[Mrk.6.51|Mrk.6:51]] εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, [[Mat.20.17|Mat.20:17]] εἰς τ. ἱερόν, with inf. (M, _Pr._, 205), [[Luk.18.10|Luk.18:10]] with mention of place of departure, [[Mat.3.16|Mat.3:16]] (ἀπό), [[Act.8.39|Act.8:39]] (ἐκ);
(b) **of things, to rise, spring up, come up**: a fish, [[Mat.17.27|Mat.17:27]] smoke, [[Rev.8.4|Rev.8:4]] plants growing, [[Mat.13.7|Mat.13:7]] metaphorically, of things coming up in one's mind (as _Heb._ לֵב אֵל עָלָה; [[4Ki.12.4, |4Ki.12:4, ]]al.), [[Luk.24.38|Luk.24:38]], [[1Co.2.9|1Co.2:9]]; of prayers, [[Act.10.4|Act.10:4]] messages, [[Act.21.31|Act.21:31]] (for late exx., see MM, _VGT_, see word)
(AS)

G0321.def:
**ἀν-άγω **
[in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi. ;]
**to lead or bring up**: before είς, with accusative loc., [[Mat.4.1|Mat.4:1]], [[Luk.2.22; 4.5|Luk.2:22 4:5]] (WH om. είς, κ.τ.λ.), [[Act.9.39; 16.34|Act.9:39 16:34]]; of raising the dead (cl.), ἐκ νεκρῶν, [[Rom.10.7|Rom.10:7]], [[Heb.13.20|Heb.13:20]]; to produce and set before, τ. λαῷ, [[Act.12.4|Act.12:4]] (MM, _VGT_, see word); in sacrificial sense (MM, 1 with), to offer, θυσίαν, [[Act.7.41|Act.7:41]] Mid., in nautical sense (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.), **to put to sea**: [[Luk.8.22|Luk.8:22]], [[Act.13.13; 16.11; 18.21; 20.3, 13; 21.1-2; 27.2, 4; 27.12, 21; 28.10-11|Act.13:13 16:11 18:21 20:3, 13 21:1-2 27:2, 4 27:12, 21 28:10-11]] (cf.ἐπ-ανάγω).†
(AS)

G0393.def:
**ἀνα-τέλλω **
[in LXX for צָמַח, פָּרַח, זָרַח, etc. ;]
1. **trans., to cause to rise**: [[Mat.5.45|Mat.5:45]]
2. **Intrans., to rise**: φῶς, [[Mat.4.16|Mat.4:16]] (= [[Isa.9.1|Isa.9:1]]); ὁ ἥλιος, [[Mat.13.6|Mat.13:6]], [[Mrk.4.6; 16.2|Mrk.4:6 16:2]], [[Jas.1.11|Jas.1:11]]; νεφέλη, [[Luk.12.54|Luk.12:54]] φωσφόρος, [[2Pe.1.19|2Pe.1:19]] ὁ Κύριος, prob. with ref. to metaphorically of sun or star, [[Heb.7.14|Heb.7:14]] (cf. ἐξ-ανατέλλω).†
(AS)

G0347.def:
**ἀνα-κλίνω **
[in LXX: [[3Ma.5.16|3Ma.5:16]] * ;]
**to lay upon, lean against, hence, **
(a) **to lay down**: [[Luk.2.7|Luk.2:7]]
(b) **to make to recline**: [[Mrk.6.39|Mrk.6:39]], WH, mg., [[Luk.12.37|Luk.12:37]] Pass., **to lie back, recline**: [[Mat.8.11; 14.19|Mat.8:11 14:19]], [[Luk.13.29|Luk.13:29]].†
_SYN._: ἀνάκειμαι (which see), ἀναπίπτω (AS)

G0345.def:
**ἀνά-κειμαι **
[in LXX: I [[Est.4.10|Est.4:10]], [[Tob.9.6|Tob.9:6]] א * ;]
1. in cl., as pass. of ἀνατίθημ, **to be laid up, laid**: [[Mrk.5.40|Mrk.5:40]] Rec.
2. In late writers (cf. MM, _VGT_, see word) = κεῖσθαι, κατακεῖσθαι, **to recline at table**: [[Mat.26.20|Mat.26:20]] part. ἀνακείμενος, [[Mat.9.10; 22.10-11; 26.7|Mat.9:10 22:10-11 26:7]], [[Mrk.6.26; 14.18; 16.14|Mrk.6:26 14:18 16:14]], [[Luk.22.27|Luk.22:27]], [[Jhn.6.11; 12.2; 13.23, 28|Jhn.6:11 12:2 13:23, 28]].†
_SYN._: ἀνακλίνω, ἀναπίπτω, the latter denoting an act rather than a state and thus in [[Jhn.13.25|Jhn.13:25]] differing from ἀνάκειμαι (see. [[Jhn.13.23|Jhn.13:23]]) by indicating a change of position. (AS)

G0308.def:
**ἀνα-βλέπω **
[in LXX chiefly for נָשָׂא ;]
1. **to look up**: [[Mrk.8.24|Mrk.8:24]], al.; before εἰς, [[Mat.14.19|Mat.14:19]], al. (Xen., Plat.).
2. **to recover sight **(Plat., Aristoph.; cf. MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Mat.11.5|Mat.11:5]], [[Jhn.9.11|Jhn.9:11]], al
(AS)

G0373.def:
**ἀνα-παύω**,
[in LXX for fourteen different words, chiefly נוּחַ, also רָבַץ, שָׁאַן, etc. ;]
**to give intermission from labour, to give rest, refresh**: [[Mat.11.28|Mat.11:28]], [[1Co.16.18|1Co.16:18]], Phm 20; pass., Phm 7, [[2Co.7.13|2Co.7:13]]. Mid., **to take rest, enjoy rest**: [[Mat.26.45|Mat.26:45]], [[Mrk.6.31; 14.41|Mrk.6:31 14:41]], [[Luk.12.19|Luk.12:19]], [[Rev.6.11; 14.13|Rev.6:11 14:13]]; as in _Heb._ ofIs 11:2 (עַל נוּחַ), τὸ πνεῦμα ἐφ᾽ ὑᾶμς ἀ., [[1Pe.4.14|1Pe.4:14]] (In π. this word is used as a technical agricultural term; see MM, _VGT_, see word; and cf. Le 2634 f.; Cremer, 826.)†
(AS)

G0372.def:
**ἀνά-παυσις**, -εως, ή
(ἀνάπαύω) [in LXX chiefly for נוּחַ and its derivatives, שַׁבָּת and its cognates (Ex, Le) ;]
**cessation, rest, refreshment**: [[Mat.11.26; 12.43|Mat.11:26 12:43]], [[Luk.11.24|Luk.11:24]], [[Rev.4.8; 14.11|Rev.4:8 14:11]].†
_SYN._: ἄνεσις (lit, the relaxation of the strings of a lyre), prop. signifies the rest or ease which comes from the relaxation of unfavour­able conditions, as, e.g. affliction: ἀνάπ., the rest which comes from the temporary cessation of labour (see Tr., Stn., § xl; Cremer, 827; MM, _VGT_, see word) (AS)

G0314.def:
**ἀνα-γινώσκω**
(Attic ἀναγιγν-), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
1. to know certainly, know again, recognize.
2. **Of written characters, to read**: [[Mat.24.15|Mat.24:15]], [[Mrk.13.14|Mrk.13:14]], [[Act.15.31; 23.34|Act.15:31 23:34]], [[Eph.3.4|Eph.3:4]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.22.31|Mat.22:31]], [[Mrk.12.10|Mrk.12:10]] [[Luk.6.3|Luk.6:3]], [[Jhn.19.20|Jhn.19:20]], [[Act.8.30, 32|Act.8:30, 32]], [[2Co.1.13|2Co.1:13]], [[Rev.1.3|Rev.1:3]]; with accusative of person(s), Ἠσαίαν τ. προφήτην, [[Act.8.28, 30|Act.8:28, 30]]; before ἐν, [[Mat.12.5; 21.42|Mat.12:5 21:42]], [[Mrk.12.26|Mrk.12:26]] (so. ἐν τ. νόμῳ), [[Luk.10.26|Luk.10:26]] before ὅτι, [[Mat.19.4; 21.16|Mat.19:4 21:16]]; τί ἐποίησε, [[Mat.12.3|Mat.12:3]], [[Mrk.2.25|Mrk.2:25]]; pass. [[2Co.3.2|2Co.3:2]] of reading aloud (MM, _VGT_, see word), [[Luk.4.16|Luk.4:16]], [[Act.13.27; 15.21|Act.13:27 15:21]], [[2Co.3.15|2Co.3:15]], [[Col.4.16|Col.4:16]], [[1Th.5.27|1Th.5:27]] (M, _Th._, in l).†
(AS)

G0338.def:
**ἀν-αίτιος**, -ον
(αἰτία), [in LXX: [[Deu.19.10, 13; 21.8-9|Deu.19:10, 13 21:8-9]] (נָקִי), Dan LXX TH Sus1:62, always of αἷμα (of. MM, _VGT_, see word)* ;]
**guiltless, innocent**: [[Mat.12.5|Mat.12:5]], 7.†
(AS)

G0378.def:
**ἀνα-πληρόω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא, [[Lev.12.6|Lev.12:6]], al.; also שָׁלַם ([[Gen.15.16|Gen.15:16]], [[1Ki.7.51|3Ki.7:51]], [[Isa.60.20|Isa.60:20]]), etc. ;]
1. **to fill up, make full **(in π. of com­pleting contracts and making up rent; cf. MM, _VGT_, see word): τόπον, take one's place (cf. _Heb._ מָקוֹם שָׁלַם), [[1Co.14.16|1Co.14:16]] άμαρτίας, complete the number, [[1Th.2.16|1Th.2:16]] τ. νόμον, observe perfectly, [[Gal.6.2|Gal.6:2]] pass., προφητεία, fulfilled, [[Mat.13.14|Mat.13:14]]
2. **to supply**: τό ὑστέρημα, [[1Co.16.17|1Co.16:17]], [[Php.2.30|Php.2:30]] (Cremer, 838).†
(AS)

G0303.def:
**ἀνά **
prep. (the rarest in NT; M, _Pr._, 98; MM, _VGT_, see word), prop.,
upwards, up, always with accusative
1. **In phrases**: ἀ. μέσον, among, between, with genitive, [[Mat.13.1-58; 25.1-46|Mat.13:1-58 25:1-46]], [[Mrk.7.31|Mrk.7:31]], [[1Co.6.5|1Co.6:5]] (M, _Pr._, 99), [[Rev.7.17|Rev.7:17]] [so in LXX for בְּתוׄך׃]; ἀ. μέρος, in turn, [[1Co.14.27|1Co.14:27]] (both found in Polyb.; cf. M_Gr._ ἀνάμεσα).
2. Distrib., **apiece, by**: [[Mat.20.9-10|Mat.20:9-10]], [[Luk.9.3|Luk.9:3]] (WH om.), [[Luk.9.14|Luk.9:14]] [[Luk.10.1|Luk.10:1]], [[Jhn.2.6|Jhn.2:6]], [[Rev.4.8|Rev.4:8]].
3. Adverbially ("a vulgarism," B1., § 51, 5; cf. Deiss., BS, 139 f.), ἀ. εἷς ἕκαστος, [[Rev.21.21|Rev.21:21]]
As prefix, ἀ. signifies
(a) **up**: ἀναβαίνειν;
(b) **to**: ἀναγγέλλειν;
(with) **anew**: ἀναγεννᾶν;
(d) **back**: ἀνακάμπτειν.†
(AS)

G0307.def:
**ἀνα-βιβάζω**
(causal of ἀναβαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi., also for רָכַב hi., etc. ;]
**to make go up, draw up, as a ship **(Xen.): σαγήνην, [[Mat.13.48|Mat.13:48]] (metaphorically, MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0315.def:
**ἀναγκάζω**
(ἀνάγκη), [in LXX: [[Pro.6.7|Pro.6:7]] (שֹׁטֵר), I [[Est.3.24|Est.3:24]], [[1Ma.2.25|1Ma.2:25]], al. ;]
**to necessitate, compel by force or persuasion, constrain**: with accusative, [[2Co.12.11|2Co.12:11]] id. with inf., [[Mat.14.22|Mat.14:22]], [[Mrk.6.45|Mrk.6:45]], [[Luk.14.23|Luk.14:23]], [[Act.26.11|Act.26:11]] (on the imperfect here, see Field, _Notes_, 141; M, _Pr._, 128 f., 247), [[Gal.2.14; 6.12|Gal.2:14 6:12]]; pass., C. inf., [[Act.28.19|Act.28:19]], [[Gal.2.3|Gal.2:3]] (for exx., see MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0377.def:
**ἀνα-πίπτω **
[in LXX: [[Gen.49.9|Gen.49:9]] (כָּרַע) [[Tob.2.1; 7.8|Tob.2:1 7:8]], [[Jdt.12.10|Jdth.12:10]], [[Sir.25.18; 32.2|Sir.25:18 32:2]], Da TH [[Sus.1.37|Sus 1:37]] * ;]
1. (cl.) to fall back.
2. **In late writers = ἀνα-κλίνομαι, to recline for a repast **(MM, _VGT_, see word): at table, [[Luk.11.37; 14.10; 17.7; 22.14|Luk.11:37 14:10 17:7 22:14]], [[Jhn.13.12; 21.20|Jhn.13:12 21:20]]; on the ground, [[Mat.15.35|Mat.15:35]] [[Mrk.6.40; 8.6|Mrk.6:40 8:6]] [[Jhn.6.10|Jhn.6:10]]; to lean back, [[Jhn.13.25|Jhn.13:25]] (T, ἐπιπεσών; see: ἀνάκειμαι, ad fin.).†
_SYN._: ἀνάκειμαι (which see), ἀνακλίνομαι (AS)

G0399.def:
**ἀνα-φέρω **
[in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi., also for קָטַר hi., etc. ;]
1. **to carry or lead up**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.17.1|Mat.17:1]], [[Mrk.9.2|Mrk.9:2]]; pass., [[Luk.24.51|Luk.24:51]] (WH, rejects, R, mg. omits); ἀ. τ. ἁμαρτίας ἐπί τ. ξύλον (see Deiss., 135, 88 f.; _ICC_, in l; MM, _VGT_, see word): [[1Pe.2.24|1Pe.2:24]]
2. **In LXX and NT, to bring to the altar, to offer **(see Hort on 1Pe, l.with): θυσίας, etc., [[Heb.7.27; 13.15|Heb.7:27 13:15]], [[1Pe.2.5|1Pe.2:5]]; ἐπί τ. θυσιαστήριον, [[Jas.2.21|Jas.2:21]] (see Mayor, in l).
3. to bear, sustain (cf. [[Num.14.33|Num.14:33]], [[Isa.53.12|Isa.53:12]]): [[Heb.9.28|Heb.9:28]].†
(AS)

G0318.def:
**ἀνάγκη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for מָצוֹק, צַר ;]
1. **necessity**: ἔχειν ἀ-, with inf., to be compelled, [[Luk.14.18; 23.17|Luk.14:18 23:17]] (Rec., R, mg.), [[1Co.7.37|1Co.7:37]], [[Jude.3|Ju 3]], [[Heb.7.27|Heb.7:27]]; ἐξ ἀ., κατ᾽ ἀ., of necessity, [[2Co.9.7|2Co.9:7]], [[Heb.7.12|Heb.7:12]], Phm 14; ἀ. μοι ἐπίκειται, n. is laid on me, [[1Co.9.16|1Co.9:16]] with inf. (= ἀναγκαῖον ἐστι), [[Mat.18.7|Mat.18:7]], [[Rom.13.5|Rom.13:5]], [[Heb.9.16, 23|Heb.9:16, 23]]
2. **force, violence, hence pain, distress **(Diod., al.; LXX; see M, _Th._, 41; MM, _VGT_, see word; cf. θλίψις): [[Luk.21.23|Luk.21:23]], [[1Co.7.26|1Co.7:26]], [[1Th.3.7|1Th.3:7]]; pl. (see B1., § 32, 6; Swete, _Mk._, 153), ἐν ἀ., [[2Co.6.4; 12.10|2Co.6:4 12:10]].†
(AS)

G0386.def:
**ἀνά-στασις**, -εως, ή
(ἀνίστημι), [in LXX: [[Zep.3.8|Zep.3:8]] (קוּם), [[Lam.3.63|La 3:63]] (קִימָה), קִימָה), [[Psa.66.1-20|Psa.66:1-20]] title., Dan LXX 11:20, [[2Ma.7.14|2Ma.7:14]] [[2Mac.12.43|2Mac 12:43]] * ;]
1. **a raising up, awakening, rising **(in Inscr. of the erection of a monument, see MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Luk.2.34|Luk.2:34]]
2. **a rising from the dead **(see _DCG_, ii, 605b);
(a) **of Christ**: [[Act.1.22; 2.31; 4.33|Act.1:22 2:31 4:33]] [[Rom.6.5|Rom.6:5]], [[Php.3.10|Php.3:10]], [[1Pe.3.21|1Pe.3:21]]; ἐξ ἀ. νεκρῶν, [[Rom.1.4|Rom.1:4]] (_ICC_, in l); ἐκ νεκρῶν, [[1Pe.1.3|1Pe.1:3]]
(b) of persons in OT hist. (e.g. [[3Ki.17.17|3Ki.17:17]] ff.): [[Heb.11.35|Heb.11:35]];
(with) **of the general resurrection**: [[Mat.22.23, 28; 22.30|Mat.22:23, 28 22:30]] [[Mrk.12.18, 23|Mrk.12:18, 23]] [[Luk.20.27, 33; 20.36|Luk.20:27, 33 20:36]], [[Jhn.11.24|Jhn.11:24]], [[Act.17.18; 23.8; 24.15|Act.17:18 23:8 24:15]], [[2Ti.2.18|2Ti.2:18]]; ἀ. ἐκ νεκρῶν, [[Luk.20.35|Luk.20:35]], [[Act.4.2|Act.4:2]]; τῶν νεκρῶν, [[Mat.22.31|Mat.22:31]], [[Act.17.32; 23.6; 24.21; 26.23|Act.17:32 23:6 24:21 26:23]], [[1Co.15.12-13; 15.21; 15.42|1Co.15:12-13 15:21 15:42]], [[Heb.6.2|Heb.6:2]]; ἀ. ζωῆς, resurrection to life (cf. [[2Ma.7.14|2Ma.7:14]], ἀ. εἰς ζωήν) and ἀ. τ. κρίσεως, τ. to judgment, [[Jhn.5.29|Jhn.5:29]] ἀ. τ. δικαίων, [[Luk.14.14|Luk.14:14]] κρείττων ἀ., [[Heb.11.35|Heb.11:35]] on ἡ ἀ. ἡ πρώτη, [[Rev.20.5-8|Rev.20:5-8]], see Swete, in l, Weste. on [[Jhn.5.1-47|Jhn.5:1-47]], but see also Thayer, see word; by meton. of Christ as Author of ἀ., [[Jhn.11.25|Jhn.11:25]] (see _DB_, iv, 231; Cremer, 307).†
(AS)

G0310.def:
**ἀνα-βοάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for צָעַק, זָעַק, קָרָא, etc. ;]
**to cry out**: [[Mat.27.46|Mat.27:46]] (WH, ἐβόησεν; see MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0363.def:
**ἀνα-μιμνήσκω**
[in LXX for זָכַר hi. ;]
**to remind, call to one's remembrance**: with accusative of thing(s), [[1Co.4.17|1Co.4:17]] with inf., [[2Ti.1.6|2Ti.1:6]] Pass., **to remember, call to mind**: [[Mrk.11.21; 14.72|Mrk.11:21 14:72]], [[2Co.7.15|2Co.7:15]], [[Heb.10.32|Heb.10:32]].†
(AS)

G0332.def:
**ἀνα-θεματίζω**
(ἀνίθεμα), [in LXX chiefly for חָרַם hi. ([[Num.21.2|Num.21:2]], [[1Sa.15.3|1Ki.15:3]], al.), [[1Ma.5.5|1Ma.5:5]] ;]
**to devote to destruction, declare or invoke ana­thema**: absol., [[Mrk.14.71|Mrk.14:71]] ἐαντόν, **to bind oneself under a curse**: [[Act.23.12, 14; 23.21|Act.23:12, 14 23:21]] (cf. καταναθεματίζω, and on the occurrence of the word in π., see Deiss., _LAE_, 92 f.; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0383.def:
**ἀνα-σείω **
[in Aq.: [[1Ki.26.19|1Ki.26:19]], [[Job.2.3|Job.2:3]]; Aq., Sm.: [[Isa.36.18|Isa.36:18]] * ;]
1. to shake out, shake back, move to and fro (Thuc., a1.).
2. In late writers (Diod., al.; see MM, _VGT_, see word), to stir up; metaphorically, **to excite**: τ. ὄχλον, [[Mrk.15.11|Mrk.15:11]] τ. λαόν, [[Luk.23.5|Luk.23:5]]†
(AS)

G0392.def:
**ἀνα-τάσσομαι **
[in LXX only as seel. (Ald.) in [[Ecc.2.20|Ecc.2:20]] ;]
**to arrange in order, bring together from memory **(Blass., Phil. Gosp., 14 ff.; MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Luk.1.1|Luk.1:1]]†
(AS)

G0327.def:
**ἀνα-ζητέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Job.3.4|Job.3:4]] (דָּרַשׁ), [[Job.10.6|Job.10:6]] (בָּקַשׁ pi.), [[2Ma.13.21|2Ma.13:21]] * ;]
to look for or seek carefully ("specially of searching for human beings, with an implication of difficulty": MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Luk.2.44-45|Luk.2:44-45]] [[Act.11.25|Act.11:25]].†
(AS)

G0380.def:
**ἀνα-πτύσσω **
[in LXX for פָּרַשׂ,etc. ;]
**to unroll**: τ. βιβλίον, [[Luk.4.17|Luk.4:17]] (WH, R, ἀνοίξας).†
(AS)

G0339.def:
**ἀνα-καθ-ίζω**
(see: καθίζω);
1. trans., **to set up**.
2. Intrans., **to sit up**: [[Luk.7.15|Luk.7:15]] (WH, mg., ἐκάθισεν), [[Act.9.40|Act.9:40]] (frequently in medical writings: MM, _VGT_, see word).
† (AS)

G0354.def:
**ἀνά-λημψις**, -εως, ἡ
(κοινή form of ἀνάληψις; see _Th._, _Gr._, 108 f.),
**a taking up**: [[Luk.9.51|Luk.9:51]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
ἀνά-ληψις, -εως, ἡ, Rec. for ἀνάλημψις, which see
(AS)

G0355.def:
**ἀν-αλίσκω**
(on the etymology, see MM, _VGT_, see word), [in LXX chiefly for אָכַל also for כָּלָה, etc. ;]
1. to expend.
2. **to consume, destroy**: [[Luk.9.54|Luk.9:54]], [[Gal.5.15|Gal.5:15]], [[2Th.2.8|2Th.2:8]], Rec. WH, mg.†
(AS)

G0322.def:
**ἀνα-δείκνυμι **
[in LXX: [[Hab.3.2|Hab.3:2]] (יָדַע), Dan LXX 1:11 (מָנָה), [[Dan.1.20|Dan.1:20]] (מָצָא), [[1Es.6.2|1Esdra.6.2]], 3Mac.9 * ;]
1. to lift up and show, show forth, declare (cf. [[2Ma.2.8|2Ma.2:8]], see MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Act.1.24|Act.1:24]]
2. **to consecrate, set apart, **(Strab., Plut., Anth.): [[Luk.10.1|Luk.10:1]]†
(AS)

G0335.def:
**ἀναιδία** (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ
(αἰδώς), [in LXX: [[Sir.25.22|Sir.25:22]] * ;]
**shamelessness, importunity**: [[Luk.11.8|Luk.11:8]] (for exx. from π., see MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0360.def:
**ἀνα-λύω**
[in LXX: I [[Est.3.3|Est.3:3]], [[Tob.2.9|Tob.2:9]], [[Jdt.13.1|Jdth.13:1]], [[Sir.3.15|Sir.3:15]], [[Wis.3.1-19; 2.1-24|Wis.3:1-19 2:1-24]],3 Mac.10 * ;]
1. to unloose.
2. **to unloose for departure, depart **(MM, _VGT_, see word): from life, [[Php.1.23|Php.1:23]]
3. to return, [[Luk.12.36|Luk.12:36]]†
(AS)

G0381.def:
**ἀν-άπτω **
[in LXX chiefly for יָצָא ;]
**to kindle**: [[Luk.12.49|Luk.12:49]], [[Jas.3.5|Jas.3:5]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0385.def:
**ἀνα-σπάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for לָקַח, עָלָה hi. ;]
**to draw up**: [[Luk.14.5|Luk.14:5]], [[Act.11.10|Act.11:10]] (in π. of pulling up barley; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0376.def:
**ἀνά-πηρος** (WH, -ειρος; see Field, _Notes_, 67), -ον (πηρός, maimed)
[in LXX: [[Tob.14.2|Tob.14:2]] א, [[2Ma.8.24|2Ma.8:24]] * ;]
**maimed, crippled**: [[Luk.14.13, 21|Luk.14:13, 21]].†
(AS)

G0326.def:
**ἀνα-ζάω**, -ῶ
[in Al.: [[Gen.45.27|Gen.45:27]] * ;]
**to live again, regain life **(cf. cl. ἀναβιόω; Cremer, 722; and for other exx., v MM, _VGT_, see word): metaphorically of moral revival, [[Luk.15.24|Luk.15:24]] (WH, mg., ἔζησεν); of sin, [[Rom.7.9|Rom.7:9]]†
(AS)

G0398.def:
**ἀνα-φαίνομαι **
[in LXX for צָדַק hi., גָּלַשׁ ;]
**to bring to light, make to appear**: ἀναφάναντες τ. Κύπρον, i.e. having sighted C.: [[Act.21.3|Act.21:3]] WH; pass., **to appear, be made manifest**: [[Luk.19.11|Luk.19:11]]
(AS)

G0334.def:
**ἀνάθημα**, -τος, τό
(cf. ἀνάθημα, and see MM, _VGT_, see word), [in LXX often as seel. for ἀνάθεμα (חָרַם), and in [[Num.21.3|Num.21:3]], [[Jdg.1.17|Jdg.1:17]] for חׇרְמָה, but prop. in [[3Ma.3.17|3Ma.3:17]], al. ;]
**a gift set up in a temple, a votive offering**: [[Luk.21.5|Luk.21:5]] (LT, -θεμα).†
(AS)

G0364.def:
**ἀνάμνησις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναμιμνήσκω), [in LXX: [[Psa.38.1-22; 70.1-5|Psa.38:1-22 70:1-5]] title. (זָכַר hi.), [[Lev.24.7|Lev.24:7]] (אַזְכָּרָה), [[Num.10.10|Num.10:10]] (זִכְרוֹן), [[Wis.16.6|Wis.16:6]] * ;]
**remembrance**: εἰς τ. ἐμὴν ἀ., [[Luk.22.19|Luk.22:19]] (WH om.), [[1Co.11.24-25;|1Co.11:24-25]] ἀ. ἁμαρτιῶν, [[Heb.10.3|Heb.10:3]] (see Abbott, _Essays_, 122 ff.; _DCG_, ii, 74a).†
_SYN._: ὑπόμνησις (see Tr., _Syn._, § cvii). (AS)

G0375.def:
**ἀνα-πέμπω **
1. **to send up, **
(a) **to a higher place **(Æsch., Plat., al.);
(b) **to a higher authority **(Deiss., BS, 229; MM, _VGT_, see word; cf. also Field, _Notes_, 140): [[Luk.23.7, 15|Luk.23:7, 15]], [[Act.25.21|Act.25:21]].
2. **to send back **(Pind.): [[Luk.23.11|Luk.23:11]], Phm 11.†
(AS)

G0350.def:
**ἀνα-κρίνω **
[in LXX: [[1Sa.20.12|1Ki.20:12]] (חָקַר), Dan LXX [[Sus.1.13|Su 1:13]], LXX, TH [[Sus.1.48, 51|Su 1:48, 51]] * ;]
**to examine, investigate, question **(Lft., _Notes_, 181 f.): [[Act.17.11|Act.17:11]], [[1Co.2.14-15; 4.3-4; 9.3; 10.25; 10.27; 14.24|1Co.2:14-15 4:3-4 9:3 10:25 10:27 14:24]]; in forensic sense (MM, _VGT_, see word; esp. of examination by torture; see Field, _Notes_, 120 f.), [[Luk.23.14|Luk.23:14]], [[Act.4.9; 12.19; 24.8; 28.18|Act.4:9 12:19 24:8 28:18]].†
_SYN._: see: ἐξετάζω (AS)

G0396.def:
**ἀνα-τρέπω **
[in LXX for דָּחָה, הָדַף, etc. ;]
**to overturn, destroy**: [[Jhn.2.15|Jhn.2:15]] WH, txt.; metaphorically, **to subvert **(MM, _VGT_, see word): [[2Ti.2.18|2Ti.2:18]], [[Tit.1.11|Tit.1:11]].†
(AS)

G0312.def:
**ἀν-αγγέλλω **
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַד hi ;]
1. **to bring back word, report **(Æsch., Thuc., al.): [[Jhn.5.15|Jhn.5:15]] (WH, εἶπεν), [[Act.14.27; 15.4|Act.14:27 15:4]], [[2Co.7.7|2Co.7:7]]
2. Later, = ἀπαγγέλλω (MM, _VGT_, see word), to announce, **declare **(LXX; Cremer, 24): [[Mat.28.11|Mat.28:11]] (WH, ἀπ-), [[Jhn.4.25; 16.13-15|Jhn.4:25 16:13-15]], [[Act.19.18; 20.20, 27|Act.19:18 20:20, 27]] [[Rom.15.21|Rom.15:21]], [[1Pe.1.12|1Pe.1:12]], [[1Jn.1.5|1Jn.1:5]].†
(AS)

G0390.def:
**ἀνα-στρέφω **
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;]
1. **to overturn**: [[Jhn.2.15|Jhn.2:15]]
2. **to turn back, return**: [[Act.5.22; 15.16|Act.5:22 15:16]].
3. **to turn hither and thither**; pass., **to turn oneself about, sojourn, dwell**: [[Mat.17.22|Mat.17:22]] Rec.; metaphorically (like _Heb._ הָלַךְ, in κοινή writers and in π.; see Deiss., _LAE_, 315; BS, 88, 194; MM, _VGT_, see word), **to conduct oneself, behave, live**: [[2Co.1.12|2Co.1:12]], [[Eph.2.3|Eph.2:3]], [[1Ti.3.15|1Ti.3:15]], [[Heb.10.33; 13.18|Heb.10:33 13:18]], [[1Pe.1.17|1Pe.1:17]], [[2Pe.2.18|2Pe.2:18]].
† _SYN._: περιπατέω (Hellenistic), πολιτεύω (AS)

G0336.def:
**ἀν-αίρεσις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναιρέω), [in LXX: [[Num.11.15|Num.11:15]] (הָרַג), [[Jdg.15.17|Jdg.15:17]] (רָמָה), [[Jdt.15.4|Jdth.15:4]], [[2Ma.5.13|2Ma.5:13]] * ;]
1. a taking up or away (Thuc.).
2. **a destroying, slaying, murder **(Field, _Notes_, 116; MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Act.8.1|Act.8:1]]†
(AS)

G0316.def:
**ἀναγκαῖος**, -αῖα, -αῖον
(ἀνάγκη), [in LXX: [[Est.8.13|Est.8:13]], [[Wis.16.3|Wis.16:3]], Sir prol.22, [[2Ma.4.23|2Ma.4:23]] [[2Mac.9.21|2Mac 9:21]], [[4Ma.1.2|4Ma.1:2]] * ;]
1. **necessary**: [[Act.13.46|Act.13:46]], [[1Co.12.22|1Co.12:22]], [[2Co.9.5|2Co.9:5]], [[Php.2.25|Php.2:25]], [[Tit.3.14|Tit.3:14]], [[Heb.8.3|Heb.8:3]]; comp. -αιότερον, [[Php.1.24|Php.1:24]]
2. **Of persons connected by bonds of nature or friendship, near, intimate **(Field, _Notes_, 118; ΜΜ, _VGT_, see word): ἀ. φίλοι, [[Act.10.24|Act.10:24]]†
(AS)

G0320.def:
**ἀνά-γνωσις**, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Neh.8.8|Neh.8:8]] (מִקְרָא), I [[Est.9.48|Est.9:48]], Sir prol. 9, 13 * ;]
1. recognition (Hdt.).
2. **reading **(Plat., al.): of the public reading of Scripture (Milligan, _NTD_, 173, 210 f.): [[Act.13.15|Act.13:15]], [[2Co.3.14|2Co.3:14]], [[1Ti.4.13|1Ti.4:13]] (Cremer, 158; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0384.def:
**ἀνα-σκευάζω**
(σκεῦος, a vessel),
prop, **to pack up baggage, hence, to dismantle, ravage, destroy**; metaphorically, **to unsettle, subvert **(MM, _VGT_, see word): ψυχάς, [[Act.15.24|Act.15:24]]†
(AS)

G0374.def:
**ἀνα-πείθω **
[in LXX: [[Jer.29.8|Jer.29:8]] (נָשָׁא hi.), [[1Ma.1.11|1Ma.1:11]] * ;]
**to per­suade, incite**: [[Act.18.13|Act.18:13]] (cf. MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0368.def:
**ἀν-αντί-ρητος**
(Τ, -ρρητος, -ον (ῥητός, spoken), [in Sm.: [[Job.11.2; 33.13|Job.11:2 33:13]] * ;]
**not to be contradicted, undeniable**: [[Act.19.36|Act.19:36]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0331.def:
**ἀνάθεμα**, -τος, τό
(ἀνατίθημι),
Hellenistic for Attic ἀνάθημα (Bl., § 27, 2);
1. prop. = τὸ ἀνατιθέμένον, that which is laid by to be kept, a votive offering (as ἀνάθημα in [[2Ma.2.13|2Ma.2:13]], [[Luk.21.5|Luk.21:5]]—where LT read -θεμα, see M, _Pr._, 46).
2. [As equiv. in LXX for חֵרֶם,] devoted, a thing devoted to God (see Driver, De., 98 f., and cf. [[Lev.27.28-29|Lev.27:28-29]]), hence;
(a) of the sentence pronounced ([[Deu.13.15|Deu.13:15]]), **a curse**: [[Act.23.14|Act.23:14]]
(b) of the object on which the curse is laid, accursed ([[Deu.7.26|Deu.7:26]]): [[Rom.9.3|Rom.9:3]], [[1Co.12.3; 16.22|1Co.12:3 16:22]], [[Gal.1.8-9|Gal.1:8-9]] (see _ICC_ on Ro.; Lft., _Ga._, ll. with; Cremer, 547; Tr., _Syn._, § v; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0325.def:
**ἀνα-δίδωμι **
[in LXX: [[Sir.1.22|Sir.1:22]], [[2Ma.13.15|2Ma.13:15]] * ;]
1. to give forth, send up, as of plants (Hdt., al.).
2. **to give up, yield, hand over **(MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Act.23.33|Act.23:33]]†
(AS)

G0394.def:
**ἀνα-τίθημι **
[in LXX chiefly for חָרַם (Cremer, 546) ;]
to lay upon, set up, etc. Mid. -εμαι, in late writers (Plut., al.; see also MM, _VGT_, see word), **to set forth, declare**: [[Act.25.14|Act.25:14]], [[Gal.2.2|Gal.2:2]].†
(AS)

G0311.def:
**ἀναβολή**, - ῆς, ἡ
(ά αβάλλω), [in LXX for בּנף, etc. ;]
**delay**: [[Act.25.17|Act.25:17]] (for exx. of other meanings, see MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0351.def:
**ἀνά-κρισις**, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX: [[3Ma.7.5|3Ma.7:5]] * ;]
**an examination**: spec. of legal preliminary investigation, [[Act.25.26|Act.25:26]] (see MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0324.def:
**ἀνα-δέχομαι **
[in LXX: [[2Ma.6.19|2Ma.6:19]] [[2Mac.8.36 |2Mac 8:36 ]]* ;]
1. to assume, undertake (in π. frequently as legal term: MM, _VGT_, see word): ἐπαγγελίας, [[Heb.11.17|Heb.11:17]]
2. = cl. ὑποδέχομαι, **to receive**: of guests, [[Act.28.7|Act.28:7]]†
(AS)

G0379.def:
**ἀναπολόγητος**, -ον
(ἀπολογεόμαι),
**without excuse, inexcusable **(in Polyb., al., as a forensic term; see Lft., _Notes_, 252): [[Rom.1.20; 2.1|Rom.1:20 2:1]].†
(AS)

G0342.def:
**ἀνακαίνωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀνακαινόω),
**renewal**: [[Rom.12.2|Rom.12:2]], [[Tit.3.5|Tit.3:5]] (Cremer, 324; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
_SYN._: παλινγενεσία, in NT, new birth, of which ἀ. is the conse­quent renewal or renovation, in which man as well as God takes part (see Tr., _Syn._, § xviii) (AS)

G0346.def:
**ἀνα-κεφαλαιόω**, ῶ
(see: κεφαλαιόω) [in _Th._, Al.: [[Psa.72.20|Psa.72:20]] * ;]
**to sum up, gather up, present as a whole**: mid., [[Rom.13.9|Rom.13:9]], [[Eph.1.10|Eph.1:10]] (on WH. see Lft., _Notes_, 321 L; AR, in l; Cremer, 354, 748).†
(AS)

G0370.def:
**ἀν-άξιος**, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ἄξιος), [in LXX: [[Jer.15.19|Jer.15:19]] א2 (זָלַל), [[Est.8.13|Est.8:13]], [[Sir.25.8|Sir.25:8]] * ;]
**unworthy**: with genitive, [[1Co.6.2|1Co.6:2]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0371.def:
**ἀναξίως**
(see supr.), adv., [in LXX: [[2Ma.14.42|2Ma.14:42]] * ;]
**in an unworthy manner**: [[1Co.11.27|1Co.11:27]]†
(AS)

G0343.def:
**ἀνα-καλύπτω **
[in LXX chiefly for גָּלָה ni., pi. ;]
**to unveil**: metaphorically of removing hindrance to perception of spiritual things, [[2Co.3.14; 3.18|2Co.3:14 3:18]].†
(AS)

G0341.def:
**ἀνα-καινόω**, -ῶ
= ἀνακαινίζω (cf. MM, _VGT_, see word),
**to make new**: [[2Co.4.16|2Co.4:16]], [[Col.3.10|Col.3:10]] (see Cremer, 323).†
(AS)

G0391.def:
**ἀνα-στροφή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀναστρέφομαι) [in LXX: [[Tob.4.14|Tob.4:14]], [[2Ma.5.8|2Ma.5:8]] [[2Mac.6.23|2Mac 6:23]] * ;]
1. a turning down or back, a wheeling about (Soph., Thuc., al.).
2. In late writers (Polyb., al.; see: ἀναστρέφω, and cf. Hort on [[Jas.3.13|Jas.3:13]] MM, _VGT_, see word), manner of life, **behaviour, conduct**: [[Gal.1.13|Gal.1:13]], [[Eph.4.22|Eph.4:22]], [[1Ti.4.12|1Ti.4:12]], [[Heb.13.7|Heb.13:7]], [[Jas.3.13|Jas.3:13]], [[1Pe.1.15; 1.18; 2.12; 3.1-2; 3.16|1Pe.1:15 1:18 2:12 3:1-2 3:16]], [[2Pe.2.7; 3.11|2Pe.2:7 3:11]].†
(AS)

G0330.def:
**ἀνα-θάλλω**
(θάλλω, to flourish), [in LXX: [[Psa.28.7|Psa.28:7]] (עָלַז), [[Ezk.17.24|Eze.17:24]] (פָּרַח hi.), [[Hos.8.9|Hos.8:9]], [[Wis.4.4|Wis.4:4]], [[Sir.5.1-15|Sir.5:1-15]] * ;]
**to revive**: [[Php.4.10|Php.4:10]] (of MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0362.def:
**ἀνα-μένω **
[in LXX for קָוָה pi. ;]
to await "one whose coming is expected, perhaps with the added idea of patience and confidence" with accusative, [[1Th.1.10|1Th.1:10]] (see M, _Th._, in l; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0329.def:
**ἀνα-ζωπυργέω**, -ῶ
(ζωός, πῦρ), [in LXX: [[1Ma.13.7|1Ma.13:7]] * ;]
**to kindle afresh**: metaphorically, [[2Ti.1.6|2Ti.1:6]] (for vernac. exx., see MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0359.def:
**ἀνά-λυσις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναλύω),
a loosing, e.g. of a vessel from its moorings, **hence, departure**: from life, [[2Ti.4.6|2Ti.4:6]]†
(AS)

G0388.def:
**ἀνα-σταυρόω **
1. **to impale (Hdt.).**
2. **to raise on a cross, crucify** (Polyb., al.).
3. **to crucify again**: [[Heb.6.6|Heb.6:6]] (see Westc., in l).†
(AS)

G0357.def:
**ἀνα-λογίζομαι **
[in LXX: [[Wis.17.13|Wis.17:13]] א, [[2Ma.12.43|2Ma.12:43]] A, [[3Ma.7.7|3Ma.7:7]] * ;]
**to consider**: [[Heb.12.3|Heb.12:3]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0313.def:
**ἀνα-γεννάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: Sir prol.17 א* (ΑΒאc παρα-)* ;]
**to beget again**: metaphorically, of spiritual birth, [[1Pe.1.3; 1.23|1Pe.1:3 1:23]] (cf. Cremer, 147; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0328.def:
**ἀνα-ζώννυμι **
[in LXX: [[Jdg.18.16|Jdg.18:16]], [[Pro.31.17|Pro.31:17]] (חָגַר)* ;]
**to gird up**: figuratively, τ. ὀσφύας τ. διανοίας, [[1Pe.1.13|1Pe.1:13]]†
(AS)

G0317.def:
**ἀναγκαστῶς **
_adv._,
**necessarily or by constraint**: opposite to ἑκουσίως, [[1Pe.5.2|1Pe.5:2]] (rare).†
(AS)
